module.title: Federated Authentication Providers and Identity Linking
module.business_purpose: Generic, provider-adaptable federated login and user provisioning. Registers identity providers (OIDC, SAML 2.0, OAuth2, social, enterprise) with their protocol configuration and signing keys, binds them per tenant with auto-provisioning rules, maps external claims to platform attributes, links external subjects to platform users, and records every login attempt for security. Extends iam (authentication_credentials.identity_provider) into a first-class, configurable federation layer; distinct from module 27 identity_assurance (proofing/IAL/AAL).
